narrative: Demand for PL1__M52FB120 is smooth and normal-like (CV=0.33, 106 working days observed), with no structural trend detected over the Sep 2025–Mar 2026 window. Lead time is short on average (1.57 days) but highly variable (CV=0.59), making lead-time variability the dominant uncertainty driver at 83.4% of total sigma_LTD. A classical (r,Q) continuous-review policy was selected: the EOQ of 31,816 substantially exceeds the MOQ, and the statistically derived safety stock of 2,547 units represents an 87.5% reduction from the current SAP setting of 20,450 units, yielding annual savings of $1,004.82 while maintaining the 95% service level.
warnings: SAP safety stock (20,450) is 8x larger than the statistically required level (2,547) for 95% SL — significant over-buffering detected.
Lead time is classified as unstable (CV=0.59); supplier engagement to improve consistency is recommended.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth normal-like demand (CV=0.33) with a well-defined EOQ (31,816) clearly exceeding MOQ (11,452) makes a classical (r,Q) policy the optimal and simplest fit. Continuous review is preferred over periodic review given the short effective lead time (2.51 days) and need to react quickly to lead-time spikes.
research_insights.boundary_risk: No capacity infeasibility. Peak stock (SS+OQ=34,363) uses 75% of max_storage_units (45,810), leaving 11,447 units of buffer. No capacity-driven order quantity reduction was required.
